notes: Double-chamber pilot freeze dryer: drying chamber with 5 stainless shelves (350x400 mm, 59 mm spacing, 0.70 m2) behind an acrylic front door, ice condenser chamber (10 kg, -88 C, approx. 50 l) directly behind or beneath it with an intermediate valve, three refrigeration compressors (2x1.2 kW + 0.9 kW) and vacuum pump in the lower cabinet. Outer envelope 1190 W x 1303 H x 968 D mm including the hydraulic stoppering device, approx. 750 kg, 3x400 V/50 Hz, 64 dB(A). Shelf -60 to +60 C (<+-1 K), ramp up to >2 K/min. All numbers from the Martin Christ Pilot Freeze Dryers brochure EN 10/2017 (snapshot research/v5/cache/59e39ed209fac3ab.txt). The stages temperature_K for shelves is the -60 C minimum. No magnetic field, mechanical refrigeration only, LN2 booster option not fitted.
